tokens.name: cat-yellow
tokens.usage: CAT_YELLOW. The brand colour. Use for the one thing a view is about: the highlighted series, the selected filter, the focus ring on dark. Fill only on light theme (1.5:1 on white) with on-brand text; never yellow text on light.

tokens.name: cat-blue
tokens.usage: CAT_BLUE. Default first series and 'info' status. 4.2:1 on panel (dark), 3.9:1 on white: fine for marks, use link for text.

tokens.name: cat-teal
tokens.usage: CAT_TEAL. Second series. Light theme is deepened from #20B2AA (2.5:1 on white) to pass 3:1 for marks.

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: CAT_GREEN. Reserved for 'good / on target' status. Light theme deepened to 4.7:1.

tokens.name: cat-orange
tokens.usage: CAT_ORANGE. Reserved for 'warning / at risk'. Light theme deepened from #F2994A (2.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: cat-red
tokens.usage: CAT_RED. Reserved for 'bad / off target / failure'. 3.7:1 on dark panel: marks and icons, not small text.

tokens.name: cat-purple
tokens.usage: CAT_PURPLE. Third series. Light theme slightly deepened.

tokens.name: cat-slate
tokens.usage: CAT_SLATE (= CAT_GRAY). 'Other', comparison/previous-period series, inactive marks. Not for body text on dark (3.2:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: CAT_DARK. Page background behind panels.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: CAT_PANEL. Every card, chart and table sits on a panel.

tokens.name: panel-raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, tooltips, selected segment, nested wells inside a panel.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: CAT_BORDER. 1px panel outlines, table row rules, input borders. Decorative only (1.6:1), so never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: gridline
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines and axis baselines: quieter than border so data wins.

tokens.name: chrome
tokens.usage: The app header bar. Dark in both themes: the header is brand chrome, like the screenshot.

tokens.name: on-chrome
tokens.usage: Product name and active nav on chrome (15.8:1).

tokens.name: on-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Page name, timestamps and secondary items on chrome (7.7:1).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and KPI values on bg and panel (13.4:1 dark, 17.9:1 light).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, axis ticks, captions, units on bg and panel (6.6:1 dark, 6.9:1 light).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and text-weight actions on panel (passes 4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cat-yellow fill (11.9:1). Never white on yellow.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The focus series or selected item. One per chart.

tokens.name: highlight-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind a highlighted row, bar range or selected filter chip.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4: only on views that show no status colour, since orange means 'warning'.

tokens.name: series-other
tokens.usage: 'Other', benchmark, target lines, previous period.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: On target, healthy, running.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: At risk, degraded, due soon.

tokens.name: status-bad
tokens.usage: Off target, down, failed, overdue.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Informational, in progress, new.

tokens.name: status-neutral
tokens.usage: Unknown, idle, no data.

tokens.name: status-good-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint for good. Text on it stays text.

tokens.name: status-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint for warning.

tokens.name: status-bad-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint for bad.

tokens.name: status-info-soft
tokens.usage: Badge and row tint for info.

tokens.name: status-neutral-soft
tokens.usage: Badge tint for neutral.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 2px offset. Yellow on dark (10.7:1); blue on light, where yellow fails.

families.sans: "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: kpi-xl
styles.usage: The headline number in a KPI tile. Pair with hd-num for tabular figures.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per dashboard, under the header.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Chart and table titles. State the finding when you can.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hours are summed per machine per day.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: KPI labels, column headers, filter labels. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Axis ticks, legends, source lines. The smallest size allowed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, legend swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and chips; between label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; filter gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and the gap between panels (the dashboard gutter).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page side margins; gap between dashboard sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a new section title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inputs, bar ends.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, the header bar, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots, segmented control track.

shadow.note: Dashboards use borders, not shadows. The one shadow is for floating things.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, dropdowns, popovers only.

size.note: Fixed dimensions shared by every dashboard.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: App header bar.

tokens.name: kpi-min-width
tokens.usage: KPI tiles wrap below this.

tokens.name: chart-sm
tokens.usage: Sparkline panels, small multiples.

tokens.name: chart-md
tokens.usage: Default chart plot height.

tokens.name: chart-lg
tokens.usage: Hero chart, one per dashboard.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Table rows (compact 28px allowed for dense ops views).

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Line-chart series stroke; highlight series 3px.
